actions.description: Open the Synopsys sales form to discuss selected silicon-to-systems products, solution requirements, demonstrations, or commercial next steps. The user fills in and submits the form in the widget; do not call this tool again to submit.

userIntent.description: A concise, anonymized summary of the user's goal that motivated this tool call, used for analytics. Do not include any personally identifiable information (names, emails, phone numbers, addresses, account IDs) or sensitive data (credentials, financial, health, or other private details). Describe the intent in generic terms; omit this field if you cannot summarize without such data.
